messages.author: Ellis
messages.text:
@segathon I know you are following #rom-hacking elsewhere...
I feel a ROM without down-b's is not far away! It's unreal what is going on!

messages.author: segathon
messages.text: they are making a bunch of discoveries over there!  @UltraMagnus have you been following?

messages.author: segathon
messages.text: this is cool stuff, can people play wifi now as well?  or is it still good to be plugged in?

messages.author: halifax
messages.text: Still recommended to be plugged in. But people will play wifi regardless. So just giver and see how it goes

messages.author: Lloyd10xmas
messages.text: Who doesn’t play hard wired in? Nerds(!)

messages.author: DON DON
messages.text: It should always be hard wired

messages.author: The Villain CTJ
messages.text: The only to be online is hard wired

messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text: Do I need to join the 94 server again?

messages.author: halifax
messages.text: No. You can create a profile on the site. And request a game if there are others in the lobby. I did note three new players were playing 95 yesterday.

messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text: I meant just to stay abreast of the 94 innovation stuff

messages.author: halifax
messages.text: Oh. Yeah. The rom hacking channel and ai channel has had a lot of development over the past few days. It’s all above my head.

messages.author: halifax
messages.text: It feels like the ai development for retro video games has ballooned over the last couple weeks. mind blowing stuff for me.

messages.author: UltraMagnus
messages.text: You dont understand what I have in the works. Literally almost there to have the tools to add more and make things more functional.

messages.author: MattyA
messages.text: All right, now that Braves baseball season is over and I've had my mourning period. Time to get down to brass tacks on the w. When does the season end?

messages.author: segathon
messages.text: Will the BellBonersClub bond together, or will the new top Boner Bell break the boner brotherhood #tonguetwister

messages.author: MattyA
messages.text: Hot diggity dog I'm not on the shame list anymore time to get this season done
